thread:
lina: Hey @it-support — just did a SIM port, my phone number changed and now Okta keeps sending MFA to the old number. I'm locked out of Okta, Gmail, and 1Password. Any fast recovery path?

it-support: Sorry about that, Lina. Can you confirm if you have a backup MFA method enabled (Okta Verify app, U2F key, or backup codes)? If not we'll need to escalate and do a manual reset.

lina: I didn't set up passkeys or U2F yet. I do have 1Password open on my laptop but the session might be expired.

samir: @it-support if you can do a temporary device-trust exception, that might let her login from the laptop. Otherwise we need to re-provision her Okta MFA.

it-support: Creating a support ticket now and tagging security for device-trust bypass. Please hang tight.

it-ticket-bot: New ticket created: IT-4821 — Okta MFA recovery for user lina (priority: P2)

jess: @lina — if 1Password works on the laptop you can try this: open 1Password, go to Account > Emergency Kit and use the backup codes for Okta. If you don't see Emergency Kit ping me and I'll send a new seat invite.

lina: 1Password shows me signed in but I don't see Emergency Kit. When I try to open Okta it redirects to SMS step and fails.

it-support: @lina I'm going to temporarily disable SMS factor for your account and enable Okta Verify push. You'll get a prompt to enroll a new factor. Expect an email in ~10 mins.

maya: FYI if we disable SMS we should ensure customer SSO policies aren't impacted. @security we need sign-off.

samir: @it-support once that's done can we also enable passkey enrollment so Lina can use a security key or platform passkey as backup? That avoids SMS.

it-support: Ticket IT-4821 updated: SMS factor disabled, Okta Verify enabled for enrollment. Please check your laptop and let us know.

lina: I got the enroll prompt and Okta Verify push worked! Logged in and can access Gmail. Thank you 🙏

jess: Great — I'll check 1Password seat and send an invite if needed. Lina, once you're set, please save backup codes and register a passkey.

lina: Will do. Thanks everyone :tada:

it-ticket-bot: Ticket IT-4821 closed by it-support (resolution: MFA re-enrolled, passkey recommendation provided).
